name: TFA Camp: Traditional Track
description_short: A day camp at the Weymouth Club for ages 6-13, with campers grouped by age. Each day includes tennis lessons, fitness and gym games, arts and crafts, and free swim, with swim lessons twice a week. It runs every summer week and on many school-vacation days.
refund_policy_summary: There are no refunds. All withdrawals or cancellations must be emailed to TFACamp@weymouthclub.com.
swim_waterfront_notes: Indoor club pool (Aquatics Center). Swim lessons twice a week plus daily free swim. Bring a bathing suit and towel every day.
